title: Are NEW Chinese buildings really FALLING DOWN?
summary: The ADVChina hosts tour a villa neighborhood in southern China that was built only three years earlier and is already empty and deteriorating. They use it to discuss ghost cities, building quality and the real estate bubble.
why: HN commenters cite it in threads on China's housing glut and construction quality as visual evidence of poor, empty new buildings.

quote.text: This video from last year was pretty eye opening to me.
